title: Final answer audit of MPPSC 2012 Prelims Paper-I

summary.answer_authority: Independently verified from primary and standard sources; no authenticated MPPSC 2012 Paper I answer key was located.
summary.method: All 100 questions were reassessed against primary and standard sources. The 79 integrated answers were re-verified and preserved. Ten previously unkeyed items were resolved with cited evidence; eleven defective or genuinely ambiguous items were documented and left unkeyed. Every question received the 2013-2024 four-part explanation with per-option reasoning, key concepts, revision takeaways and preserved sources.
